create_datalab_marker_loader: create a DatalabMarkerLoader instance to process documents via the Marker API with configurable OCR and output format
run_loader_load: run the DatalabMarkerLoader.load method to upload a file and retrieve extracted text as a LangChain Document
check_marker_request_status: check the DatalabMarkerLoader.check_marker_request_status method to poll the Marker API for a processing request by ID
get_mime_type: get the MIME type for a file extension using DatalabMarkerLoader._get_mime_type for PDF, DOCX, XLSX, and image formats
build_document_from_file: build a LangChain Document from a local file by uploading it to Marker and returning markdown or JSON output
